<function name="GetBrightness" parent="Color" type="classfunc">
	<description>Converts a <page>Color</page> into [HSV color space](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV) and returns the [brightness also known as "value"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brightness).

See <page>COLOR:ToHSV</page> if you want to get all 3 components.
</description>
	<file line="277-L282">lua/includes/util/color.lua</file>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<added>2025.01.23</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="brightness" type="number">Brightness in range [0, 1]</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
